_source_of_truth: This spec is the source. Render with the umbrella draw-diagram skill; never hand-edit the generated .drawio or .png.
_used_by: content-s1/scripts/scenario/build_enrolline_solution_designs.py — figure in the Enrolline Baseline Solution Design (when wired)
_intent: How the components fit together, not how they are configured. Sizes, engine versions and settings live in the written specifications.
_layout_notes: Deliberately the same shape as the Ledgerline baseline diagram — same grid, same straight centre traffic line — so a student who has seen one reads the other immediately.

The ONE structural difference is Amazon S3: it is a regional service and is drawn OUTSIDE the VPC, reached from the NAT Gateway. That placement is the teaching point — Enrolline's document store is not in a subnet, and its traffic leaves the VPC because no S3 VPC endpoint exists.
The S3 path runs in the clear band between the public subnet row (ends y=420) and the app subnet row (starts y=500), so it crosses no container fill.
Empty second-AZ subnets are drawn narrower than populated ones: the geometry says 'less here' before the label is read.
Subnet labels carry both the scenario AZ and the Learner Lab AZ, so a student can match what the console shows them.
_matches: assessments/AT3/lab-pack/baseline.yaml and src/content/ict/enrolline-server-status-cloud.md — the as-built single-AZ environment CL3 improves.
